note: Declare a better DRAFTER instead of a faster kernel. Acceptance is the drafter predicting the target's next token -- identical arithmetic on any GPU -- so unlike occupancy tuning it is hardware-independent and should transfer to the M5. Measured on trunk, same binary, ONLY the head changing, at 512 local decode tokens (at 64 tokens every head saturates at accept 0.982-1.000 because the public fixtures are longcopy COPY tasks and cannot discriminate): distill-d3 accept 0.9068 / meanDraft 6.527 / score 1.2724 vs the incumbent q2-q4-rerank head at accept 0.8770 / meanDraft 6.359 / score 1.2303, i.e. +3.4%. Reproducible: distill-d3 measured 1.2721 and 1.2724 on two independent runs (0.02% spread), incumbent 1.2343 and 1.2303. Ranked below it in the same sweep: distill-d2-v3a 0.8826/1.2364, q4-islands-v3a 0.8770/1.2295, ftorange 0.8509/1.2153, morgan 0.8549/1.1924 -- acceptance ranking tracks score ranking in both directions, so the instrument discriminates. Head weights are an operator-ratified part of the competitive surface; a head only PROPOSES and the pinned target still decides every emitted token.
